extendedinputbox-default-title: Default popup dialog title, used when "popup-title" is not set on the <inputbox>.
extendedinputbox-btn-save: Label of the button that submits the popup form.
extendedinputbox-btn-cancel: Label of the button that cancels/closes the popup form.
extendedinputbox-default-pagename: Default target page name, used when no "page=" parameter and no field value can be resolved.
extendedinputbox-default-username: Fallback value for the {{USER}}/{{REVISIONUSER}} magic words when no user is logged in.
extendedinputbox-error-unresolved-title:
Error shown when the generated page title still contains unresolved template braces. Parameters:
* $1 - the generated (invalid) title
extendedinputbox-error-preload-fetch:
Error shown when the preload template could not be fetched during a skip-edit publication. Parameters:
* $1 - the preload template title that failed to load
extendedinputbox-error-publish:
Error shown when the MediaWiki API returns an error while publishing a page via skip-edit. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-error-popup-preload-dep: Error shown when the deprecated "popup-preload" parameter is used in an <inputbox> configuration.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bgcolor: Error shown when "button-bgcolor" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bordercol: Error shown when "button-border-color" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-duplicate-field:
Error shown when the same field name is used in more than one "popup-field" parameter within a single <inputbox>. Parameters:
* $1 - the duplicated field name
extendedinputbox-required-marker: Default short marker appended to a field's label when it is required ("required=yes" on "popup-field"). It can be overridden per form with "required-marker=" or "popup-required-marker=".
extendedinputbox-error-field-required:
Error shown when a required field ("required=yes" on "popup-field") is left empty at submission time. Parameters:
* $1 - the field's label
extendedinputbox-formbuilder: Name/description of Special:FormBuilder shown on Special:SpecialPages.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-intro: Short introductory text shown at the top of Special:FormBuilder.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-section-gen: Heading of the panel with the general <inputbox> parameters (type, page, buttonlabel, etc.).
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-section-fie: Heading of the panel listing the popup-field rows of the form being built.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-section-tar: Heading of the panel used to load, edit, preview and publish the target page.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-type: Label of the dropdown selecting the InputBox "type=" parameter (search, create, comment, move).
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-page: Label of the text field for the InputBox "page=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-prefi: Label of the text field for the InputBox "prefix=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-defau: Label of the text field for the InputBox "default=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-butto: Label of the text field for the InputBox "buttonlabel=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-prelo: Label of the text field for the InputBox "preload=" parameter.
Label of the text field for the "preload-params=" parameter (comma-separated field names).
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-summa: Label of the text field for the InputBox "summary=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-popup: Label of the text field for the "popup-title=" parameter.
Label of the text field for the "popup-text=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-requi: Label of the text field for the "required-marker=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-hidem: Label of the checkbox that forces an empty "required-marker=" value (hides the marker entirely).
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-skipe: Label of the checkbox for the "skip-edit=yes" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-bgcol: Label of the text field for the "button-bgcolor=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-borde: Label of the text field for the "button-border-color=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-type-none: Dropdown option meaning the "type=" parameter is left unset.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-row-n: Placeholder of the "name" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-row-l: Placeholder of the "label" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-row-o: Placeholder of the "options" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-row-s: Placeholder of the "show-if" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-row-r: Label of the "required" checkbox inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-type-: Field type option: single-line text input.
Field type option: multi-line text input.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-addfiel: Label of the button that adds a new popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-removef: Label of the button that removes a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-moveup: Label of the button that moves a popup-field row up.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-movedow: Label of the button that moves a popup-field row down.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-no-fields: Placeholder text shown in the fields list when no popup-field has been added yet.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-drag-hint: Tooltip on the drag handle of a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-generated-l: Heading above the read-only textarea showing the generated <inputbox> block.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-targe: Placeholder of the title input used to choose the target page to load.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-load: Label of the button that fetches the target page's wikitext via the API.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-insert: Label of the button that inserts the generated wikitext at the cursor position.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-preview: Label of the button that renders a preview of the target page's current wikitext.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-publish: Label of the button that saves the target page via the API.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-wikitext-la: Placeholder of the textarea containing the target page's wikitext.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-preview-lab: Heading above the rendered HTML preview of the target page.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-preview-loa: Placeholder text shown while the preview is being fetched from the API.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-newp: Notice shown after loading a target page that does not exist yet.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-load: Notice shown after successfully loading the target page's wikitext.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-inse: Notice shown after inserting the generated wikitext into the target textarea.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-publ: Notice shown after successfully saving the target page, just before redirecting to it.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-notit: Error shown when trying to load a page without having entered a title.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-load:
Error shown when the API call to load the target page fails. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message or the page title
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-previ:
Error shown when the action=parse API call fails. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-publi:
Error shown when the action=edit API call fails for a reason other than a permission problem. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-noedi: Generic error shown when the current user cannot edit the target page and no detailed reason could be retrieved from the API.

Error shown when the current user cannot edit the target page, including the specific reason returned by the MediaWiki API (protection, block, read-only mode, abuse filter, etc.). Parameters:
* $1 - the detailed reason, already translated by the API (errorformat=plaintext)
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-editc: Error shown when publishing fails because the target page was edited by someone else since it was loaded (edit conflict). Should invite the user to reload the page.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-btn-copy: Label of the button that copies the generated wikitext to the clipboard.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-copi: Transient confirmation shown next to the copy button after a successful clipboard copy.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-copy-: Transient error shown next to the copy button when the clipboard copy failed (e.g. insecure context, permission denied).
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-warning-inc:
Live validation warning shown under the generated wikitext when a popup-field row is missing its name and/or label, meaning it is silently skipped when generating the wikitext. Parameters:
* $1 - the 1-based position of the incomplete field row
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-status-load: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while the target page is being fetched.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-status-prev: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while a preview is being generated.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-status-publ: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while the target page is being saved.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-noins: Error shown when trying to insert, preview or publish before a target page has been loaded.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-confirm-ove: Confirmation dialog shown before publishing changes to an already-existing page.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-summary-def: Default edit summary used when publishing from Special:FormBuilder without a custom "summary=" value.
